Abstract: "we show that prompt distillation outperforms standard supervised fine-tuning and can even surpass RAG." Intro: "On Squadshifts, its closed-book performance can match that of open-book RAG. In the more complex HotpotQA, RAG is a strong baseline. However, PD improves closed-book performance substantially and, more importantly, enhances RAG when used together." Conclusion: "In knowledge injection tasks from Squadshifts, PD achieves closed-book performance competitive with RAG when the number of training questions and the LoRA rank are sufficient." HotpotQA: "When combined with RAG, models trained with PD generally show superior performance."
notes: SCOPED FINDING — the claim is qualified, not absolute. (1) Squadshifts, Llama-3-8B (Table 2): closed-book PD is 'near-RAG' — beats RAG on Reddit (79.5 vs 78.6), ties Amazon (86.1 vs 86.3), loses New Wiki (94.4 vs 95.6) and NYT (93.6 vs 96.3); PD+RAG is highest overall. PD XL + Tülu 3 (Table 5: 89.4/96.2/95.9/80.3) exceeds the embeddings-RAG baseline (86.3/95.6/96.3/78.6) on Amazon/New Wiki/Reddit but not NYT (95.9 vs 96.3), and on average "outperforming all other methods" (Fig. 1). (2) Squadshifts, Qwen2.5-14B: closed-book PD (85.5/94.9/92.6/77.6) trails instruct+RAG (87.1/97.1/94.8/81.3) on all four datasets; PD+RAG (88.4/97.3/96.3/83.6) beats RAG. (3) Squadshifts, Qwen2.5-3B: closed-book PD (76.4–90.0) is well below RAG (75.3–94.5 range, e.g. 76.4 vs 85.4 Amazon); only PD+RAG surpasses the non-fine-tuned RAG baseline. (4) HotpotQA (Table 7): RAG remains stronger than closed-book PD for ALL three models (PD 73.7 vs Base+RAG 79.5 for Llama-8B; 73.4 vs 83.5 for Qwen-14B; 59.1 vs 73.5 for Qwen-3B), but PD+RAG beats plain RAG everywhere (82.1 vs 79.5; 87.0 vs 83.5; 76.9 vs 73.5). Net: PD surpasses/matches RAG closed-book only on Squadshifts with Llama-3-8B (and on average with PD XL); at 3B/14B scale and on HotpotQA, RAG stays ahead of closed-book PD and PD's advantage is via the PD+RAG combination.

SCOPED FINDING — the paper's claim is 'can even surpass', never an absolute 'surpasses everywhere'. Exact scope from Tables 2, 5, 7: (1) Squadshifts, plain closed-book PD vs base+RAG: Llama-3-8B near-parity — PD 86.1/94.4/93.6/79.5 vs RAG 86.3/95.6/96.3/78.6 (PD ahead only on Reddit); Qwen2.5-14B RAG stronger on all four (PD 85.5/94.9/92.6/77.6 vs RAG 87.1/97.1/94.8/81.3); Qwen2.5-3B RAG clearly stronger closed-book (PD 76.4/90.0/84.6/65.6 vs RAG 85.4/94.5/91.9/75.3). (2) Where PD actually surpasses RAG: (a) PD+RAG beats base+RAG for all three models (e.g. Llama 88.5/96.7/96.9 vs 86.3/95.6/96.3; Qwen-3B 86.5/94.8/95.0/75.6 vs 85.4/94.5/91.9/75.3); (b) scaled 'PD XL + Tülu 3' (200 Qs, Bonito, 1 epoch) exceeds the RAG baseline closed-book on 3 of 4 subsets (89.4 vs 86.3 Amazon, 96.2 vs 95.6 New Wiki, 80.3 vs 78.6 Reddit) but not NYT (95.9 vs 96.3); Fig. 1 shows PD XL 'outperforming all other methods' on average. One exception: 'SFT with distractors achieves the best RAG performance on the Reddit dataset' (82.4 vs PD+RAG 77.8, Llama). (3) HotpotQA: RAG remains stronger than closed-book PD (best PD 73.7/73.4/59.1 vs Base+RAG 79.5/83.5/73.5); PD surpasses RAG only in combination (PD+RAG 82.1/87.0/76.9 vs Base+RAG 79.5/83.5/73.5). So 'PD surpasses RAG at multiple scales' holds only for PD+RAG combos and for scaled PD XL on Squadshifts averages; plain PD merely approaches RAG on Squadshifts (Llama) and trails it on Qwen closed-book and on HotpotQA.

Scoped finding — the claim is qualified ('can even surpass'), not absolute. (1) Squadshifts closed-book: PD roughly MATCHES instruct+RAG for Llama-3-8B (PD 86.1/94.4/93.6/79.5 vs Instruct+RAG 86.3/95.6/96.3/78.6 on Amazon/NewWiki/NYT/Reddit) and stays below instruct+RAG for Qwen2.5-14B (85.5/94.9/92.6/77.6 vs 87.1/97.1/94.8/81.3) and Qwen2.5-3B (76.4/90.0/84.6/65.6 vs 85.4/94.5/91.9/75.3); the outright closed-book-beats-RAG result requires the scaled variant: PD XL (Llama-3-8B, 200 Qs, Bonito, 1 epoch) 'exceeding the OpenAI Embeddings-based RAG baseline on knowledge injection tasks'. (2) Squadshifts PD+RAG surpasses instruct+RAG at all three scales (8B: 88.5/96.7/96.9 vs 86.3/95.6/96.3; 14B: 88.4/97.3/96.3/83.6 vs 87.1/97.1/94.8/81.3; 3B: 86.5/94.8/95.0/75.6 vs 85.4/94.5/91.9/75.3), with one exception: Llama-3-8B Reddit, where PD+RAG 77.8 < Instruct+RAG 78.6 and SFT-with-distractors+RAG is best at 82.4. (3) HotpotQA: RAG remains stronger than closed-book PD at every scale (best closed-book PD 73.7/73.4/59.1 vs Base+RAG 79.5/83.5/73.5 for Llama-8B/Qwen-14B/Qwen-3B), but PD+RAG surpasses Base+RAG at all scales (82.1/87.0/76.9). So: PD surpasses the plain RAG baseline at multiple scales only in the PD+RAG combination (Squadshifts and HotpotQA) and closed-book only via PD XL on Squadshifts/Llama-3-8B; plain closed-book PD matches RAG on Squadshifts (Llama-3-8B) and remains below RAG on HotpotQA.

The scoring is task-performance evaluation on labeled validation examples: math accuracy requires the ground-truth numerical answers of the verifiable DAPO problems; text-game scoring requires environment outcome/reward.
